name: delivery_change
description: Protected, two-step. Change a granted application from home delivery to collection, or back, while nothing is paid on it (AD-07). The read-back gives the new total from the rules; say it as given. A payment card still waiting for a choice, code or PIN is not paid: this works then and closes that card. After a payment is approved it is refused: offer create_case instead.

to.description: home: delivered home (adds KES 200, paid with the fee); collect: collected free at the desk

application_id.description: application_id from application_submit on this call. Leave it out on a later call: the caller's newest granted application in the open service is used.

confirmation_id.description: Empty the first time; after the caller says yes, the confirmation_id you were given
